primitives.name: Center-to-Quarterback Handoff Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: 170 AMERICAN FOOTBALL then swing up under the line, practicing passes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v_handoff': 'Velocity of ball at handoff (m/s)', 'v_center': "Velocity imparted by center's push (m/s)", 'v_quarter': "Velocity from quarter's upward swing (m/s)"}
primitives.assumptions: (1) Ball motion confined to vertical plane; (2) negligible air drag; (3) rigid body impulse approximation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Handoff velocity mismatch > 2 m/s triggers fumbling singularity.

primitives.name: Center Forward-Movement Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: As the center passes the ball, he should move forward.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Center moves only along the line of scrimmage; (2) constant forward speed assumption.
primitives.breakdown_regime: v_center_x < 0 causes backward momentum transfer, increasing fumble risk.

layer2.mapping: Enforces geometric consistency for GSI handoff precision
layer2.telemetry: Forward velocity component of center relative to scrimmage line

primitives.name: Daily Practice Frequency Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: During the first half of the year the center and quarter should do this daily, and they should return to this exercise whenever there is a tendency to fumble.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Fumble probability decays exponentially with recent practice; (2) independent trials model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Long disuse t >> λ^{-1} leads to memory loss singularity.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies skill maintenance for GSE situational awareness
layer2.telemetry: Days since last dedicated handoff drill session
